nom: Good Molecules Soothing Azelaic Acid Cleanser

avis.texte: A few hours afterwards, my face was so bumpy I thought I was breaking out into a rash. Nope, clogged pores. This just wasn't compatible with my skin type apparently. I have never had problems with any other products of theirs, and I use a lot.
I started getting small little pimples after using. Wanted to like it, sadly did not work for me. After cleansing, my face did feel clean.
-gentle but effective -creamy texture -purging can happen for 4-8 weeks -no added fragrance

I liked how this made my skin feel after each use, it felt clean but mot stripped. The smell was tolerable but it smelt like bubble solution to me. It caused a bunch of small closed comedones to pop up around my cheeks, so i had to sadly return this because my intent was to combat my current acne break outs and post acneic scars.

I really like this! Im currently 37weeks pregnant and have been using this for about 3 weeks now. I have combination skin. It has cleared up my blemishes and has kept the little pimples away. I pair it with the lightweight daily moisturizer and sometimes the hyaluronic acid serum and they have worked well together for me! Im very prone to redness and these products have not caused any redness for me!! The smell isn't bad either imo.
Broke me out so bad :/ I didn't think it smelled like some other reviewers but this was such a miss for me
Want to say I love it because I love the brand, but it broke me out in little clogged pores. (Havent broke out since before acccutane ) stopped immediately.

avis.titre: Love this product! Great for acne relief
avis.texte: This product has done wonders for my face! I had acne breakout and what I had been using previously wasn't working so I tried this and it is clearing my face wonderfully!

avis.titre: Could not get past the smell
avis.texte: I was looking forward to using this product!! I have been looking for a new azelaic acid products to use. The lather was great snd my face felt fresh. Unfortunately, the smell was absolutely horrible and I could not get past it, so I returned it.

I like it. IMO, the scent is pale, minimal. Similar to the Phisoderm brand scent from the 80's and 90's. The face cleanser is inexpensive, good packaging, good ingredients. Does the job as a second step cleanser. Don't need much.

Purchased this with the hopes of using a gentle Azaleic Acid product since I have sensitive skin. Started to develope closed comedones out of no where. I'm not super acne prone so this was unordinary. Read the ingredients and it contains Carrageenan which is up there with coconut oil comedogenicly speaking! Might work for most but wanted to put it out there!

This product seemed really promising but it smells terrible! Literally it makes me gag I cannot use it. I tried contacting good molecules to see if it was just the azelaic acid or something else in it too. They never got back to me.

I started using this cleanser after experiencing a reaction to a previous skincare product. My skin has been so clear (no breakouts) and brighter in conjunction with the azelaic acid serum. I highly recommend. I'm loving the Good Molecules line.

I'm a foaming cleanser girlie. So trying this cleanser out was a very different experience my skin is loving. I usually reach Peach Slice Snail Cleanser and she's my go to but this is right up there in my favorite now. Soothing, helped with my texture, my skin doesn't feel tight after rinsing it off. My skin is soft and hydrated daily... WITH their new azelaic acid. It's a win win for me.

I just tried this for the second time. It feels slightly like a tingling and burning sensation but mild. If you have tried a PHA I would say the end result feels just like that. A PHA exfoliant. Very mild. The smell is not bad. Very faint and dissipates quickly. The texture is like a lightweight gel/slimy feeling which I like. It does leave your skin slightly dry but nothing over the top. It does calm down redness for me. If it gets on your lips you might feel that tingling sensation which I don't like. It also has a "cooling" affect when you use it. I don't know if I want to stick with this or my other exfoliant. I would say this product is not necessary or life changing unless you really have a lot of redness with sensitivity that you want to calm down. It's a good price point and I do see a lot of folks liking it. I'll see what 2026 brings with "brightening" products in the near future. I paid for this with my own coins.

Calms the skin for sure and very easy to apply and washes off smoothly. Definitely calms down the redness 100%. I love Good molecules, I just wish they offered more products without hyaluronic acid as my skin gets fairly reactive to it :/

I purchased this myself. I am a licensed Esthetician and I have used just about everything you can imagine, from affordable to WAY overpriced. This cleanser is a dream. Like some other reviewers, I also have peri-oral dermatitis flares at times - mostly due to product sensitivity - if I'm trying something new. I was having a minor flare when this arrived in my shipment and thought it would be the perfect time to test it. I used it once in the evening and let me tell you, I woke up the next morning and the dermatitis was completely gone. Vanished! I love Azelaic Acid; it's a stellar ingredient that's not given the credit it deserves. If you have reactive skin and are worried about the word "acid" in this product, don't be. This is an affordable cleanser that outperforms most expensive ones I have in my arsenal. I absolutely 100% recommend this. Please do not ever change the formula. What GM created here is absolute perfection!

avis.titre: Can't get past the horrible smell
avis.texte: I was really looking forward to using this cleanser for the azelaic acid and other great ingredients. Unfortunately the smell is absolutely horrible and I could not get past it. :(
I started using this cleanser and I'm impressed that reduces oils and texture on my skin. I am definitely going to try other products as well from this brand.

I've tried so many products to soothe my perioral dermatits: azelaic acid creams, niacinimide, sulfur creams, and zinc barrier creams. None of them have worked as well or as quickly as this cleanser did at calming my perioral dermatitis. The morning after using this cleanser, the patches around my mouth were calm and stayed that way all day. This cleanser also feels great on the rest of my oily, acne-prone face. It will definitely become my go-to cleanser from now on, especially with how cheap it is.
I use this cleanser allot every morning and night. It the slick texture feels great on my skin and is really effictive for my oily skin.

I have combo skin that tends to breakout with acne and sebaceous filaments. This cleanser does not foam but will slightly bubble with manipulation, I love how it makes my skin feel clean but doesn't leave that tight itchy feeling. I usually massage into my skin for at least 60 seconds and double cleanse with it when I have on makeup. I've seen a noticeable improvement in pore appearance as well as texture. It also does not break my sensitive skin out! Best cleanser for the price!

avis.titre: I love Good Molecules brand and love this product
avis.texte: I have been using Good Molecules for a few years now. My favorite is their retinol. I saw this facewash being release and bought it. My skin feels so soft after washing. I look glowier since using this facewash. The price point is wonderful too!

I just started getting perioral dermatitis so I had to start an entire new skin care routine. this cleanser is so gentle yet effective ! it calms any inflammation on ur face as well! if youre sensitive and have normal to dry skin I would definitely try it out !
Gentle yet cleansing. Def recommend Keeps my face clear and hydrated

This new cleanser by Good molecules is definitely a game changer. From the first wash, I noticed a dramatic difference on how my skin felt after washing with this product. The pictures below show real progress from just one week of using this product. Some cleansers tend to strip your skin, but this one feels light but effective. I recently discovered Good molecules earlier this year, and I have tried a lot of their products. This cleanser by far is my favorite. I love the feel of my skin after washing with this product and how it feels clean, refreshed, but not dried out like a lot of cleansers tend to do. I have acne prone skin and it has been a journey trying to get rid of the discoloration, hyper pigmentation, and acne scars over the last couple of years. So discovering the Good molecules products have been a godsend. I am kind of obsessed with them and I love how they are actually effective but super affordable. I have spent so much money on all kinds of skin care products that not only left me disappointed but feeling as though I have wasted my money. Good Molecules has truly changed the game with not only this amazing cleanser, but with all of their products, try it you won't be disappointed. Gifted by Good Molecules

I have sensitive acne prone combination skin, and in the week since starting to use this product, I've seen a massive change in my skin! I typically have pretty red skin, as I work outside and any irritation I have is exacerbated by the sun exposure regardless of the SPF. After using this cleanser, I'm seeing a massive improvement in both the amount of acne I'm seeing, as well as the appearance of my acne that I currently have. The pimples and blackheads I do have are smaller, less red and noticable, and less painful, which are all great! This cleanser is such a treat to use, the smell is lovely and floral, it's easy to get on and off, and my skin feels hydrated but still literally squeaky clean afterwards. I like this cleanser more than any other I've used. I also appreciate that this cleanser recommends that you scrub for 30 seconds to a minute, I've had better outcomes with cleansers in the past when I use it in this manner, and having that reminder with this cleanser really helps me use it correctly. I've found my regular cleanser from now on! Gifted by Good Molecules

Ok so I'll start off by saying that I only had a week to try this product out, as well as the 10% azelaic cream. So I don't think that's quite enough time to properly see how a product is for your skin. Not to mention trying two new products together. How am I supposed to know which product is doing what? And if I did half my face with one and half with the other, I wouldnt get the full effect of both at once. That said, I'll review best I can. I kept most of my routine the same. Morning: Replaced my regular salicylic acid cleanser with this one Replaced magic molecules dark spot corrector with the 10% azelaic cream Sunscreen Evening: Oil cleanser Replaced my sa soap with this one Replaced my mm dark spot corrector with the 10% azelaic cream My prescription acne cream The soap, I do it is soothing. Except for the one part of my face is that is sensitive, which is right above my top lip. This soap says to leave on your face for 30-60 seconds. So I went with 60. It irritated that spot on my face, and made it red and hurt. I was able to sooth it with a lotion I have, and I just ended up not putting it on that part of my face for the rest of the week. So if you have sensitive skin, I would be cautious or leave it on for a shorter amount of time. It's a pretty thin consistency, but it works onto your skin well. It doesn't really lather, but as you have to leave it on for a bit, I don't mind the lack of lather. It was quite cool on my face. When I washed it off, it made my skin ver

I was scared to use this at first because my skin is sooooo tricky and sensitive. When I first used this product I noticed its gel-like texture but i also noticed how its NOT A HEAVY PRODUCT. After using this product my skin felt so soft & hydrated like slime kind of lol. I touch my face a few times throughout the day & I can honestly say this product has to work all day or something because its not a oily skin feel but its hydrating & made my skin feel bouncy or as a collagen makes my skin feel. I have also notcied that my breakouts have been VERY VERY VERY little with the help of the dark spots package & this new product !! I have combination skin , sometimes its oily , dry, super sensitive & always acne proned. My products are kept in my room, where its room temperature & average light exposure. At night I turn on the Ac because if I dont my skin will be super oily from being hot , I think the Ac keeps the product fresh & working. Gifted by Good Molecules

The cleanser comes in a simple, minimalist squeeze tube, which I appreciate for its hygienic and mess-free design. The texture is a rich, creamy lotion that feels luxurious without being heavy. Upon first use, I noticed it has a very subtle, natural scent, which is a big plus for those sensitive to strong fragrances. I used a nickel-sized amount of the cleanser on damp skin and massaged it in for about 60 seconds before rinsing. It doesn't foam, which is a good sign for a gentle, hydrating formula. It glides on smoothly, and it feels like it's nourishing my skin while it cleans. For my evening routine, it effectively removed light makeup and daily grime without the need for a second cleanse. Over the month, my skin's overall texture and tone have improved. It no longer reacts as harshly to changes in weather, and my complexion looks smoother and more even. Gifted by Good Molecules

This cleanser is absolutely AMAZING!!! I have oily skin with hyperpigmentation and texture issues. The cleanser is soothing, calming, and so effective! My skin feels clean, soft, and so hydrated after each wash. It has helped with the texture, hyperpigmentation , and controlling the oiliness of my skin! Would absolutely recommend! "Gifted by Good Molecules"

I have been using the cleanser for eight days now. The cleanser has a smell that I don't like you know that is working because it has a slight tingle sensation. I did notice that it doesn't foam up which I like because I wanna be able to see my face while cleansing it a little goes a long way. All you need is the size of a Pea for your entire face. I wouldn't advise to let it sit on your face for at least 30 to 45 seconds so that you can know that is working but overall that is a good cleanser. It would not be my go to cleanser every day due to the smell, I prefer my cleansers to have no sent. It is very, very smooth and glides when you do put it on your face and it comes off very easily. after I have rinsed my face off it does not feel dry cracky it feels very hydrated and crack. and I love that. gifted by good molecules.

This cleanser has been a total game-changer for my skin. I'm 34 and have combination skin that used to be much oilier, but I still struggle with those persistent sebaceous filaments in my T-zone. The texture is a soothing, creamy wash that feels incredibly comfortable and hydrating, never stripping my skin. My main skin concern was that T-zone congestion, and I've seen visible results after only a few weeks. The filaments are significantly less noticeable, and my skin feels incredibly clean and balanced throughout the day. Even though I'm not acne-prone, this clarity has made a huge difference in my skin's overall appearance. Gifted by Good Molecules
